headline: ‘It’s Very Simple’: 50 Years of Making Avant-Garde Music Sound Effortless
context: Founded by Pierre Boulez to treat new compositions with orchestral rigor, Ensemble Intercontemporain has honed the art of turning forbidding scores into expressive sound.
